papers.title: MAHA-z: A Mahalanobis distance kNN estimator for photometric redshifts
papers.summary: Learned-Mahalanobis-distance kNN with kernel-density posteriors estimates photometric redshifts for Euclid, DES and VIPERS galaxies, reaching sigma_NMAD 0.015-0.023 at low cost.

papers.title: galpy with differentiable, accelerated backends: galactic dynamics in jax and PyTorch
papers.comment: 44 pages, 28 figures, 30 code examples. galpy version 2 is available at https://github.com/jobovy/galpy and the code behind this paper's figures, together with the record of the development, at https://github.com/jobovy/galpy-backends
papers.summary: galpy gains JAX and PyTorch backends giving differentiable, GPU-accelerated potentials, orbits and distribution functions, with examples fitting the Galactic potential and learning action-angle transforms.

papers.title: ViViViT: a Video-to-Video Vision Transformer for Cosmological Lightcone Reconstruction
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to the Sim2Science Workshop (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary: Vision transformer ViViViT reconstructs 21cm lightcone matter fields as video-to-video translation, preserving power, phase and bispectrum better than a 3D U-Net baseline.

papers.title: Beyond classification: regressing physical merger properties using solid harmonic wavelet bispectrum
papers.comment: accepted for publication in MNRAS, results for regression of merger properties shown in Figs 4&7
papers.excerpt: Galaxy mergers play an important role in galaxy evolution; they enhance star formation, transform morphologies, and may drive accretion onto black holes.

papers.title: Variations in the Extinction Curve at High Galactic Latitudes as seen by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument
papers.comment: 25 pages, 15 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to AAS Journals. Data product available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23151436
papers.summary: XGBoost predicts intrinsic stellar colours from DESI spectroscopic parameters to measure reddening, revealing bimodal R(V) varying by sigma_NMAD=0.23 at high Galactic latitudes.

papers.title: CosmoSim: Lens-parameter estimation of the Einstein Cross NGC 6505 using machine learning
papers.summary: A CNN trained solely on CosmoSim simulations estimates lens and source parameters from Euclid and AGEL images, reconstructing NGC 6505 as well as published models.

papers.title: MAGI (Multivariate Autoencoder for particle Generative Inference): a generative Machine Learning framework for accelerated multi-stage particle simulations
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, submitted as Conference Proceeding for "International Conference on Machine Learning for Astrophysics 3rd Ed." (ML4ASTRO3)
papers.excerpt: Monte Carlo particle simulations are hindered by the computational cost of particle transport.

papers.title: Sky Monitor AI: classifying night-sky conditions from an observatory all-sky camera with a CNN ensemble, label-free sky types and exact evidence maps
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and application: https://github.com/waqas6767/Sky-Monitor-AI-for-Remote-Observatory-Operations
papers.summary: A CNN ensemble classifies all-sky camera frames as clear or cloudy across held-out nights with 86.7% accuracy, releasing the open-source Sky Monitor AI application.

papers.title: A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of an Astronomy Foundation Model
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. A condensed version was selected for an oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability for Discovery
papers.summary: Causal interpretability analysis of AION-1 finds its multimodal redshift advantage localized to the first encoder block and a dust-sensitive attention head.

papers.title: Identification of extragalactic radio sources in the VISTA survey of the Magellanic Clouds using an unsupervised machine learning algorithm
papers.summary: t-SNE clustering of optical-to-radio photometry for 8,008 VMC/EMU sources separates AGN, galaxies, blazars and stars, with SALT spectroscopy confirming new AGN.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) A: Strong lens catalogue overview
papers.comment: 28 pages. Submitted to A&A as part of the Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
authors: Euclid Collaboration: N. E. P. Lines
papers.summary: Euclid DR1 strong-lens catalogue reports 15,072 candidates found by a five-model machine-learning and citizen-science pipeline, with lens models and deflector properties.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) B: Discovery pipeline overview
papers.comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, submitted to A&A. Paper intended for the A&A Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
papers.summary: Multi-stage Euclid DR1 lens search combines neural-network classification of 68 million objects, citizen science and expert grading to identify 15,000 strong-lens candidates.

excluded.title: An analytic diffusion model for viewing-angle effects in explosive transients
